paras: Gastropholis echinata, the hedgehog gastropholis, is a species of lizard found in Liberia, Ivory Coast, Ghana, Cameroon, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
The Latin specific epithet of echinata refers to hedgehog, from echinus.
